newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOL unit to sell stake in Indonesian JV.
newsitem.headline: UOL unit to sell stake in Indonesian JV.

text.p: United Overseas Land Ltd (UOL) said on Wednesday its overseas investments unit had agreed to sell its stake in an Indonesian joint venture property development company.

UOL said in a statement UOL Overseas Investments Pte Ltd (UOLOI) had agreed to sell its 15 percent stake in PT United Overseas Bali Land to Singapore Land Ltd unit SL Realty Management Services (HK) Ltd (SLR(HK)).
SLR(HK) would pay UOLOI a total of about Singapore $3 million for its stake, the statement said.
Profit from the deal should be about S$633,000 and was not expected to have any material impact on UOL's earnings in the financial year to December 31, 1997.
